### Curtiss-Wright Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Raises Full-Year 2026 Guidance


November 04, 2026


DAVIDSON, N.C. -


Curtiss-Wright Corporation (NYSE: CW) reports financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026.


> Curtiss-Wright delivered a strong third quarter and we have raised our full-year guidance for all major financial metrics. Our Pivot to Growth Strategy continues to build momentum.
>
>
> Share


Third Quarter 2026 Highlights:


- Reported sales of $953 million, up 10%, operating income of $188 million, operating margin of 19.7%, and diluted earnings per share (EPS) of $3.77;
- Adjusted operating income of $189 million, up 11%;
- Adjusted operating margin of 19.9%, up 30 basis points;
- Adjusted diluted EPS of $3.94, up 16%;
- Free cash flow (FCF) of $157 million, generating 108% FCF conversion;
- Total share repurchases of $352 million;
- New orders of $1.1 billion, up 15%, reflected a 1.1x book-to-bill; and
- Backlog of $4.6 billion, up 12% year-to-date.


Raised Full-Year


2026 Adjusted Financial Outlook:


- Sales increased to new range of 8% to 10% growth (previously 8% to 9%), reflecting continued strong growth in the Aerospace & Defense (A&D) and Commercial end markets;
- Operating income increased to new range of 12% to 14% growth (previously 11% to 13%);
- Operating margin increased to new range of 19.2% to 19.4%, now up 60 to 80 basis points compared with the prior year (previously 19.1% to 19.3%, up 50 to 70 basis points);
- Diluted EPS increased to new range of $15.40 to $15.60, now up 16% to 18% (previously $15.10 to $15.40, up 14% to 16%); and
- FCF increased by $10 million to new range of $595 to $615 million, which continues to reflect greater than 105% FCF conversion.


"Curtiss-Wright delivered a strong third quarter, highlighted by double-digit growth in both revenue and operating income, and mid-teens growth in adjusted diluted EPS, as we continue to execute on the strength of our product portfolio,” said Lynn M. Bamford, Chair and CEO of Curtiss-Wright Corporation. "Orders increased 15% year-over-year, primarily driven by continued strong demand in defense electronics and growth across all of our A&D markets, reinforcing our confidence in our ability to deliver consistent and durable future growth. Based on our strong year-to-date performance, we have raised our full-year guidance for all major financial metrics. We now anticipate sales growth of 8% to 10%, along with improved profitability across all three segments, as our Pivot to Growth Strategy continues to build momentum."


"We also remain committed to deploying our strong balance sheet to support disciplined and strategic capital allocation. We are on track to deliver near-record share repurchases in 2026 and continue to drive internal investments to support our future growth, which underscores our confidence in the business and our commitment to delivering consistent and superior results for our shareholders."

- Sales of $953 million increased 10% compared with the prior year;
- Total A&D market sales increased 9%, while total Commercial market sales increased 11%;
- In our A&D markets, we experienced strong growth in the defense markets, principally driven by higher revenues on various fighter jet and helicopter programs in aerospace defense and higher submarine revenues in naval defense, as well as higher OEM sales growth in the commercial aerospace market;
- In our Commercial markets, strong growth in the power & process market was driven by higher sales of commercial nuclear solutions, while higher sales in the general industrial market reflected strong growth in industrial vehicle products; and
- Adjusted operating income of $189 million increased 11%, while Adjusted operating margin increased 30 basis points to 19.9%. This performance was driven by favorable absorption on higher revenues in all three segments and the benefits of the Company's restructuring initiatives, partially offset by unfavorable mix of products in the Defense Electronics segment.

- Free cash flow of $157 million decreased $19 million, as higher capital investments and higher tax payments more than offset higher cash earnings.


New Orders and Backlog


- New orders of $1.1 billion increased 15% compared with the prior year driven by strong demand across all of the Company's defense markets, as well as continued order growth in the commercial aerospace and general industrial end markets; and
- Backlog of $4.6 billion, up 12% from December 31, 2025, reflecting higher demand across the A&D and Commercial markets.


Share Repurchase and Dividends


- During the third quarter, the Company repurchased approximately 538,000 shares of its common stock for approximately $352 million and remains on track to repurchase a total of $460 million in shares in 2026, in-line with last year's record $466 million buyback program;
- In September 2026, the Company's Board of Directors authorized an additional $510 million for future share repurchases, increasing the total available authorization to $700 million. Entering 2027, the Company expects to have remaining open repurchase authorization of $600 million; and
- During the third quarter, the Company declared a quarterly dividend of $0.26 a share.

Use and Definitions of Non-GAAP Financial Information (Unaudited)


The Corporation supplements its financial information determined under U.S. generally accepted accounting principles (GAAP) with certain non-GAAP financial information. Curtiss-Wright believes that these Adjusted (non-GAAP) measures provide investors with improved transparency in order to better measure Curtiss-Wright’s ongoing operating and financial performance and provide more relevant comparisons of our key financial metrics to our peers. These non-GAAP measures should not be considered in isolation or as a substitute for the related GAAP measures, and other companies may define such measures differently. Curtiss-Wright encourages investors to review its financial statements and publicly filed reports in their entirety and not to rely on any single financial measure. Reconciliations of “Reported” GAAP amounts to “Adjusted” non-GAAP amounts are furnished within this release.


The following definitions are provided:


Adjusted Sales, Operating Income, Operating Margin, Net Earnings and Diluted EPS


These Adjusted financials are defined as Reported Operating Income, Operating Margin, Net Earnings and Diluted Earnings per Share under GAAP excluding: (i) the impact of first year purchase accounting costs associated with acquisitions, specifically one-time inventory step-up, backlog amortization, deferred revenue adjustments, transaction costs, and gains/losses on equity securities held for investment purposes; (ii) costs associated with the Company's 2026 Restructuring Program in the current period and the Company's 2024 Restructuring Program in the prior period, as applicable; and (iii) and gains/losses associated with recording equity securities held for investment purposes at fair value.

Free Cash Flow and Free Cash Flow Conversion


The Corporation discloses free cash flow because it measures cash flow available for investing and financing activities. Free cash flow represents cash available to repay outstanding debt, invest in the business, acquire businesses, return capital to shareholders and make other strategic investments. Free cash flow is defined as net cash provided by operating activities less net capital expenditures. The Corporation discloses free cash flow conversion because it measures the proportion of net earnings converted into free cash flow and is defined as free cash flow divided by adjusted net earnings.

About Curtiss-Wright Corporation


Curtiss-Wright Corporation (NYSE:CW) is a global integrated business that provides highly engineered products, solutions and services mainly to Aerospace & Defense markets, as well as critical technologies in demanding Commercial Nuclear Power, Process and Industrial markets. We leverage a workforce of approximately 9,300 highly skilled employees who develop, design and build what we believe are the best engineered solutions to the markets we serve. Building on the heritage of Glenn Curtiss and the Wright brothers, Curtiss-Wright has a long tradition of providing innovative solutions through trusted customer relationships.
